scripts.build:all: npm run build:ftc && npm run build:peacepad && npm run build:saywetin
scripts.build:site: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@ftc/ftc-site
scripts.build:ftc:deps: npm run build --workspace=@ftc/config && npm run build --workspace=@ftc/types && npm run build --workspace=@ftc/logger && npm run build --workspace=@ftc/supabase && npm run build --workspace=@ftc/auth
scripts.build:ftc: npm run build:ftc:deps && npm --workspace=@ftc/ftc-site run build
scripts.test: npm run test:ftc && npm run test:peacepad && npm run test:saywetin
scripts.dev:peacepad: npm --workspace=@ftc/peacepad run dev || echo 'peacepad has no dev'
scripts.dev:saywetin: npm --workspace=@ftc/saywetin run dev || echo 'saywetin has no dev'
scripts.doctor: node -v && npm -v && (test -d APPS && echo APPS ok)
